title: Syria Update — May 9, 2026
summary: Syria's security services dismantled a Hezbollah-linked assassination cell targeting senior transitional officials on May 5–6, arresting at least 11 people in nationwide raids. On May 2, Israel launched over 20 airstrikes across Syrian territory — including near the presidential palace in Damascus — and fired artillery into Quneitra while warning Syrian forces to halt operations against the Druze community. The first public trial of an Assad-era official (Atef Najib, accused of ordering 2011 Daraa torture) opened on April 26. On May 3, the UN formally ended its 11-year cross-border humanitarian aid operation from Turkey into Syria after more than 65,000 delivery journeys, as Syria and Turkey develop commercial routes under the transitional government. Six new map-line entries document Israeli strike trajectories across Syrian territory, and the days-since-regime-collapse KPI has been updated to 517 days.
